params.columns: k UInt64, a UInt64, b UInt64, c UInt64, d UInt64
params.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number + {i} * {rows} AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS a, a % 1000 AS b, k * 7 AS c, intDiv(k, 3) AS d FROM numbers({rows})

description: Paced natural merges: one 1000-row insert every 0.125 s for 10 min, then a wait until no merge has run for 60 s. Hold-out of the fitted-constant chain amplification at a tempo not measured.
